name: Vétéran de la cour
description: A compact stocky male chief with amber patterned skin, healed scratches on the cranial dome, one short outer mandible tusk and a mass of thick black dread tendrils braided with large bone rings. He wears an asymmetrical crimson shoulder cloak and a dark brown long ceremonial tunic with strong ribbed bronze chest plates. In one hand a short staff with stacked geometric bone shapes, other hand open in a measured gesture. Full intact body and complete staff.
